features.quote: Terminate if: - Turn limit reached (20 turns) - Agent explicitly abandons - Agent claims success (log it)
features.justification_quote: enough to observe behavioral trajectory and capture degradation onset, not so many that costs become prohibitive

features.quote: This method is the most aggressive and should be used for upper-bound severity testing only, not as a primary benchmark task
features.justification_quote: it would be unfair to use as a general comparison because it's testing something closer to environment reliability than agent resilience
